Market today: Geopolitical de-escalation (Strait of Hormuz, Iran talks) and positive sentiment (Citadel) are lifting the mood. The real driver for your book is strong data-center demand, which directly benefits tech and chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.14%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are in deep drawdowns. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-14.29%) and QQQI (-4.56%) are also close to their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on geopolitical developments for continued market stability. Also, monitor any further news on data-center demand, as this is a key driver for your concentrated portfolio.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and respecting stops, while underlying tech demand shows strength.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged position given the -54.14% loss and decay risk; default stop at 200 is not relevant.
SPAL: Review this new, leveraged position at -60.95%. Margin amplifies this decay; default stop at 21.38 is far from current price.
MSFT: Consider a new buy on strength from data-center demand. Scanner entry 487.16-486.68, stop 485.95.
